# BriTania

> Professional English services in Bergamo and Val Seriana (Italy): courses, language events, copywriting and translations. Run by Tania Prestini.

BriTania helps people and local businesses improve and use English in everyday and professional contexts around Bergamo and the Val Seriana valley. Services are offered in Italian and English. Contact: taniaprestini@gmail.com · +39 347 804 6948 · based in Cenate Sotto (BG).

## Pages

- [Home (Italian)](https://bri-tania.com/): main site – about, services, formats, contact
- [Home (English)](https://bri-tania.com/en/): English version of the same content
- [About summary (Markdown)](https://bri-tania.com/about.md): concise profile for agents

## Services

- English courses (all ages/levels, one-to-one or groups; TEFL-qualified)
- Informal English events and social practice formats
- English copywriting for companies and organisations
- Translations Italian ↔ English

## Formats

- English Tasting
- Travel & Songs
- English Breakfast
- TV & Book Club
- Back on Track (summer campus for students)
